alignment_filters.count_unit: Read-name fragment union; conflicting overlapping mates counted separately under other_or_conflict; not UMI molecules.
alignment_filters.indel_rule: Flanking-anchor read-span comparison across [span_start_1based, span_end_1based] (chr3:30688454-30688457 CAAC->CAAAC for TGFBR2; chr2:25247121-25247126 CAAAAC->CC for DNMT3A) excluding reads with CIGAR reference skips ('N') overlapping [span_start, span_end] and requiring continuous alignment of both anchors and min base quality >=20 across the spanned bases.
alignment_filters.rna_strand_orientation_rule: fr-firststrand (Read 1 antisense to transcript, Read 2 sense to transcript).

additional_reference_label_corrections.reference_proof: Versioned NCBI NM_022552.5 CDS and Ensembl genomic HGVS mapping for NC_000002.12:g.25247122_25247125del predict p.Phe350AlafsTer56. Guardant report label is retained separately.

annotation_revision.scope: Corrects RXRA and DNMT3A transcript-reference citations only; no genomic allele, fragment count, peptide, prediction or protein/nucleotide sequence changed. Raw BAM passes and model inference were not repeated for this annotation revision.

nonfunctional_source_revision.scope: Removed an unused import and clarified source comments. No audit logic, locus, pileup or prediction changed; no BAM/model execution was repeated. script_sha256 retains the prior annotated-source identity.

scope: Reproducible locus-level BAM fragment pileups and MHCflurry Class-I predictions for the 13 nucleotide-resolved Guardant360 cfDNA alterations. Does not establish clonality, anatomical lesion origin, mRNA translation or clinical immunogenicity.
